prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. CACE school material N4: SUBJECT + ACTION + OBJECT. Humorous anthropomorphic animal or imaginary character, retain unmistakable species features. Exactly the natural number of limbs: quadrupeds have FOUR limbs TOTAL, two can act as arms, never four legs plus extra arms. Insects retain species features. Pure white seamless background, minimal essential supporting props only. Add second living character ONLY when the target object is that character, or essential to show a human body part; no bystanders. All relevant figures and objects fully inside frame with generous margins, entire composition centered occupying at most 70 percent of frame. Correct hands/paws and plausible physical contact. Friendly and suitable for primary school. Absolutely NO text, letters, numerals, logos, signatures, speech bubbles, music notes or watermark, including books, money and clothing. Single scene, not collage.
